notes.title: New Update 1.1
notes.content:
First of all i would like to thank everyone for the support that i have been receiving, and having been listening to the all useful tips here comes the first Update 1.1.

Changes:

-Added Main Menu with the "Good ending" main theme
-Tweaked lightning in some scenes
-Performance tweaks and optimization
-Minor sound changes
-After the "Evil ending" the game now loads autosave
-After the "Good ending" the game now returns to the main menu

Best Regards and a Happy 2018 :)
